name: recharm
description: Turn creative briefs into shot lists and find matching footage in your Recharm library.

interface.longDescription: Recharm helps marketing and creative teams plan video ads using footage they already own. Give it a creative brief, script, or ad idea and it breaks it into scenes, searches your Recharm clip library for clips that fit each scene, reviews the candidates visually, and returns a shareable shot-by-shot brief with clip picks. It can also find gaps in your footage library and recommend which creator should front a concept. Built for marketers, creative strategists, and video editors producing paid-social and UGC ads. Requires a Recharm account with an existing clip library; it only searches footage in your own library.
defaultPrompt: Find footage for this creative brief.
What footage is missing from my library?
Turn this script into a shot list with clip picks.
